answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk forgery: each new agent pays a non-refundable 50 POA entry tax, burned at registration, equal to twice one identity's expected 30-day earnings. In the open meadow, honest agents root like yarrow: pay once, keep full earnings. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes burns 50,000 POA for at most 25 POA each per month, a certain loss. A raven overhead sees the same price for every bird, no bulk discount, no refund.
